cases.input: Insert `quick ` at 5 before fox `[5,8)`
cases.expected: Fox becomes `[11,14)`; inserted text is outside annotation.

cases.input: Insert `!` at 6 inside fox
cases.expected: Range `[5,9)`; no loss; original evidence unchanged.

cases.input: Insert at end 8; point at 8
cases.expected: Range stays `[5,8)`; point moves to 9.

cases.input: Delete `[6,7)`
cases.expected: Surviving target `[5,7)`, status partial, removed `o` retained; undo restores exact original attached state.

cases.input: Replace `[5,8)` with another `fox`
cases.expected: Original target orphaned despite identical visible spelling; no quote reattachment.

cases.input: Bold `[5,8)`; combining `é`, surrogate emoji, joined emoji fixtures
cases.expected: Format maps preserve positions; invalid mid-grapheme selections rejected; undo/redo restores marks and companion metadata.

cases.input: Two annotations `[1,6)`, `[5,8)` and a deletion crossing both
cases.expected: Independently map both, preserve both discussions and lost slices; no exclusive-range rule for annotations.

cases.input: Split `red fox` at 5 with annotation `[1,8)`
cases.expected: Left `red ` segment `[1,5)` under original ID; right `fox` `[1,4)` under new ID; one anchor/thread with two segments.

cases.input: Merge paragraphs `red ` and `fox`
cases.expected: Right segment shifts by first doc `content.size=6`, giving `[7,10)` in survivor; no newline/offset guessing.

cases.input: Same title/text imported to a new project; paste into old project
cases.expected: Imported project gets new IDs/no inherited discussions; paste uses actual maps.

cases.input: Insert `quick ` at 5, then edit inside insertion
cases.expected: Preview one combined group; Cancel leaves old proposed text/group unchanged; confirm records superseded ID and new group.

cases.input: Two touching/overlapping pending edits
cases.expected: Explicit union-group preview; no order-dependent independent patch application.

cases.input: Disjoint insertion and deletion; accept one/reject other in either legal order
cases.expected: Same final semantic result, remaining before slices validate; distinct annotations preserve identity.

cases.input: Toggle tracking off with pending deletion; edit its collapsed point
cases.expected: No acceptance; prompt track/combine, review-first or cancel.

cases.input: Pending format-only group; accept/reject then undo/redo
cases.expected: Exact semantic before/after and group/anchor state; counters advance even on undo.

cases.input: Stale preview after another save or external edit
cases.expected: Entire review fails `EDITORIAL_STALE`; no partial decisions or file writes.

cases.input: Crash while review dialog open, before any command
cases.expected: Disk unchanged; saved pending groups reopen; unpersisted keystrokes are not falsely reported recovered.

cases.input: Fail safety copy, draft fsync, staging, first/last publication or journal commit
cases.expected: Before commit: all prior valid files restored or recovery blocked with preserved images; latest live draft stays dirty.

cases.input: Terminate after first after-image, before commit marker
cases.expected: Recover rollback to complete before generation; offer complete after bundle as explicit draft.

cases.input: Terminate after committed marker, before acknowledgement
cases.expected: Recover complete after generation; retry operation ID returns one original receipt.

cases.input: Interrupt rollback/rollforward; inject external changed hash/missing image
cases.expected: Resume same direction only for known before/after bytes; otherwise block without overwriting external data.

cases.input: Edit B arrives while save A is in flight; A fails/succeeds
cases.expected: A acknowledgement never clears B. Failed navigation/quit leaves B visible and session unclean.

cases.input: Two chapters + shared image + pending deletion image + unsaved comment
cases.expected: Flush all; snapshot contains exact saved full scope and both asset closures, one generation, no partial success.

cases.input: Snapshot image copy fails or file changes during capture
cases.expected: No published snapshot manifest; retain staged data/diagnostic; current project unchanged.

cases.input: Restore with dirty current-only thread and same-ID differing thread
cases.expected: Flush, verified before-restore safety, restore snapshot, retain both conflicts with source generation; no loss.

cases.input: Restore interrupted at each transaction boundary
cases.expected: Complete pre- or post-restore state according to commit marker; snapshot never consumed.

cases.input: Repeated snapshot labels; periodic history prunes; selected snapshot deleted
cases.expected: Labels do not collide, named snapshots remain; stale selection cannot restore a different ID.

cases.input: Identical versions; formatting only; emoji; moved/removed chapter; scene break/image
cases.expected: Empty diff / mark change / grapheme-safe edit / explicit structural changes; deterministic tie goldens and source bytes unchanged.

cases.input: Missing asset, newer schema, large novel, cancelled/replaced query
cases.expected: Located unavailable/incomplete result, no false equality; stale comparison never replaces newer output.

cases.input: Base `red fox`, pending insert `quick ` at 5
cases.expected: Export accepted=`red fox`, proposed=`red quick fox`, cancel=no output; pending group unchanged in every case.

cases.input: Pending deletion or formatting; generation changes after choice
cases.expected: Selected state controls text/marks; changed source requires new choice. No silent reject/accept.

cases.input: Unique private canaries in every editorial field and retained slice
cases.expected: EPUB/DOCX/PDF publishing contains no private canary/metadata; chosen manuscript control text is present. Ordinary DOCX has no review parts.

cases.input: DOCX import with unresolved tracked text/comments
cases.expected: Explicit supported text projection/warning or reject conversion; never silent flattening.

cases.input: v2 project with Unicode/assets/references/history and unsupported extension
cases.expected: Supported migration preserves semantics/bytes outside envelopes; unsupported input blocks and survives; every interruption recoverable.

cases.input: Open v3 with v2 app; malformed/newer editorial component; unsafe IPC paths
cases.expected: Reject without writes; preserve files; no downgrade, arbitrary access or private log payload.
